sections.name: File setup
sections.title: Package settings, commands and libraries
sections.what: Names the API server, marks it as private, and sets it to run as ES modules. Provides the commands for development, building, starting, checking types, checking evidence and testing. Lists the libraries the server runs with and the tools used to build and type-check it.
sections.why: Reason not stated in the code. The commands match a typical build-then-run workflow.
sections.watch_out: Adding a library here without checking the bundle's external list in build.mjs can break the built server.

summary: Package manifest for the API server that names it, lists its commands, and lists the libraries it needs.
purpose: Lets pnpm and Node.js install the server's libraries and run its build, start, typecheck and test commands.
why: Reason not stated in the code for each entry. The layout is a standard one for a private package inside a larger workspace.
how: Declares the package name and marks it private so it is not published. Sets the type to module so .js files load as ES modules. Scripts: dev runs a build then start in development mode; build runs build.mjs; start runs the bundled dist/index.mjs with source maps; typecheck runs the TypeScript checker; check:scan-evidence and test run two scripts in the script folder. Lists runtime dependencies and build or type tools.
inputs: The installed package manager and Node.js. Workspace and catalog entries are resolved from the monorepo root.
outputs: A installed node_modules folder and the output of the chosen command.
risks: The dev script uses a shell command, export, that does not work in every shell, including Windows. Caret version ranges allow newer minor versions to be installed. Workspace and catalog entries break if the root configuration changes.
debug: If install fails, check the workspace and catalog entries in the root configuration. If start fails, confirm that the build created dist/index.mjs. If test fails, read the output of script/test-search-queries.ts.
